items.title: 7.3.1 Causes of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of causes of the digital divide (PDF 182-183).

blocks.text: Digital divide ki kai wajah (factors) hain:

items: Economic Barriers (paise ki rukawatein): Digital divide ki ek bari wajah paise ki kami hai. Bohat se log aur khandan computer, smartphone ya broadband internet ka kharcha bardasht nahi kar sakte. Paise ka yeh farq khaas taur par developing countries (ghareeb ya taraqqi karte hue mulkon), rural (dehaati, gaon ke) ilaqon aur kam aamdani wale logon mein nazar aata hai.

Geographical Barriers (jagah ki rukawatein): Urban (shehri) aur rural (dehaati) ilaqon mein ICT ke access (pohanch) mein bara farq hai. Duniya ke kai hisson mein, khaas taur par remote (bohat door) ya rural ilaqon mein, internet ke liye zaroori infrastructure (bunyadi dhancha, jaise towers aur cables) ya to kamzor hai ya hai hi nahi.

Educational Barriers (taleem ki rukawatein): Digital literacy ki kami bhi digital divide ki ek bari wajah hai. Technology mil bhi jaye tab bhi log sahi taleem aur training na hone ki wajah se use achhi tarah istemal karna nahi jante.

Social Barriers (muashre ki rukawatein): Umar, gender (mard ya aurat hona) aur disability (maazoori, jaise nazar ya sunne ki kamzori) bhi technology ke access par asar dalti hain. Maslan bari umar ke log nayi technology istemal karne mein kam dilchaspi rakhte hain ya kam istemal kar pate hain, aur kuch ilaqon mein auraton ko cultural (riwayat aur rasm o riwaj wali) rukawaton ki wajah se ICT ka kam access milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Hukumat har student ko muft laptop de de. Digital divide ki kaunsi wajah door hogi aur kaunsi baqi rahegi?
blocks.explanation: Device khareedne ki economic barrier door hogi. Lekin agar ilaqe mein internet nahi (geographical barrier) ya student ko istemal karna nahi aata (educational barrier), to yeh rukawatein baqi rahengi.

items: Chaar wajah: economic (kharcha), geographical (dehaati ilaqon mein infrastructure nahi), educational (digital literacy ki kami), social (umar, gender, disability).
